errors.evidence: The description states that the 'Only MoHD FFN' line starts at approximately 11.6. However, the plot shows this line starting at a PPL of approximately 11.45, which is visibly below the 'Transformer' line at 11.6.

The description states that the 'Only MoHD ATTN' line starts at 11.6. However, the plot shows this line starting at a PPL of approximately 11.45, at the same level as 'Only MoHD FFN' and below the 'Transformer' baseline.
The description incorrectly states that the 'Only MoHD ATTN' line dips at 75%. The plot shows that this line rises from approximately 11.45 at 100% to approximately 11.6 at 75%.
The PPL for 'Only MoHD ATTN' at 25% is reported as 14.0, but the data point is clearly above the 14.0 grid line, at a value of approximately 14.3.
The description claims the 'MoHD ATTN + MLP' line starts at 11.6, but the plot shows it starting at approximately 11.4, visibly below the 'Transformer' baseline of 11.6.
The value for 'MoHD ATTN + MLP' at 75% is reported as 11.7. In the plot, this point is below the 'Transformer' line (11.6), at approximately 11.55.

errors.text_span: All lines show increasing perplexity as sparsity increases (i.e., as activated parameters decrease)
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect. The 'Transformer' line is flat, and the 'Only MoHD FFN' line first decreases from 100% to 50% before increasing. Therefore, the statement is not true for two of the four lines.

The description for 'Only MoHD FFN' omits the significant dip in the line. It decreases from ~11.45 at 100% to its lowest point of ~11.3 at 50% before rising. Simply describing the start and end points misrepresents the trend.
